snippet.title: Bloodspill Steam Page and Playtest! Indie Game Devlog #0
snippet.description:
WISHLIST here 👉🏼 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3737680/Bloodspill
Hey there, welcome to a new Devlog for my indie game Bloodspill. 

Bloodspill is a fast-paced, PvP, retro fps with one hit combat, featuring classic gamemodes like deathmatch, capture the flag and conquest! 

𝙋𝙖𝙩𝙧𝙚𝙤𝙣
https://www.patreon.com/thatfain

𝘿𝙞𝙨𝙘𝙤𝙧𝙙
https://discord.gg/Y3DgBBhEJd 

If you have any question, feel free to ask them in the comments.  

But most importantly, enjoy  :) 

---------------------------------------

𝙈𝙐𝙎𝙄𝘾

Big thanks to  Davelton Powers for the music and the track "Intestinal Manslaughter"
